title: Home practical guide and safety card: blocking sound
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lessons 31, 32 (Home practical guide and safety card: blocking sound (portal worksheet; alarm on low, never near the ear))
intro: Lesson 31: Can we block sound? Planning a measured test. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which material blocks sound best
equipment: A phone or clock alarm on a low volume
Materials to test: tea towel, foil, bubble wrap, a jumper
safety: Never hold it near your ear
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Set the alarm on low and put it in the box
Stand 2 m away and score how loud it is (3 loud, 2 quiet, 1 can hardly hear, 0 silent)
Wrap the alarm in one material, the same thickness each time
Listen from the same place and score it
Decide which material blocks sound best

questions.q: Big question: what is the material in walls for?
questions.a: To block sound between rooms: sound insulation.
